user.title: Set up Huawei Dynamic IP Translator
user.description: Let Home Assistant look for the Huawei device on your local network or enter its MAC address yourself.

select.title: Choose your Huawei device
select.description: Choose the device Huawei Solar connects to. Each device shows its IP and MAC address.

manual.title: Set up Huawei Dynamic IP Translator
manual.description: After setup, reconfigure Huawei Solar to use 127.0.0.1 and the local port below. Keep the existing Modbus unit IDs.

data_description.mac: Enter the MAC address of the network device Huawei Solar connects to, such as the Smart Dongle, EMMA, or inverter.
data_description.unit_id: Use the first unit ID from the existing Huawei Solar installation. This is used to read and verify its serial number.

check_failed.title: Modbus not verified
check_failed.description: No recognisable Huawei Modbus response was received from {host}. Choose another device or retry with the port and unit ID from Huawei Solar.

connection.title: Check Modbus again
connection.description: Enter the Modbus port and unit ID for {host}.

confirm.title: Huawei found and verified
confirm.description: {model} at {host}:{port} responded over Modbus. Serial number: {serial}. Save, then configure Huawei Solar to use 127.0.0.1, port {local_port}.

confirm_existing.title: Existing Huawei Solar connection found
confirm_existing.description: {model} at {host}:{port} matches your Huawei Solar configuration. Save, then configure Huawei Solar to use 127.0.0.1, port {local_port}. The translator verifies the serial number on that first connection.

error.invalid_mac: Enter a valid MAC address, such as 94:25:33:12:34:56.
error.port_in_use: Another Huawei Dynamic IP Translator already uses this local port.
error.no_devices: No Huawei device was found. You can enter its MAC address below.

abort.already_configured: This MAC address is already configured.
abort.port_in_use: Another Huawei Dynamic IP Translator already uses this local port.

progress.scanning: Searching your local network for Huawei devices. This may take a moment.
